name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code (https://code.claude.com/docs) as a member of this collection's ecosystem: installs the sha256-verified native release binary at /usr/local/bin/claude (no Node.js, version pinnable) unless a claude is already in the image - e.g. from the official ghcr.io/anthropics/devcontainer-features/claude-code, which is then augmented instead of replaced - and adds the claude-host launcher (resume one session by UUID via HOST_SESSION, never a second copy of a running session), the claude-fleet command (several sessions in one terminal, never a second copy), a named volume mounted at CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (/var/lib/devcontainer-features/claude-code) so login and sessions survive rebuilds, a post-create hook that makes that directory usable by the remote user, and the Feature Taskfile. The in-app auto-updater is off; a rebuild updates.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

install.description: How the claude binary gets there. 'auto': keep a claude already in the image (official Feature, base image) and only add the ecosystem pieces, else install the native binary. 'native': always install the verified native binary at /usr/local/bin/claude (wins over an npm install on PATH). 'none': never install the binary, only the pieces.

version.description: Native binary version to install (e.g. '2.1.286'), or a release channel: 'stable' or 'latest'. Ignored when an existing claude is kept (install=auto) or install=none.
